marks.gloss_en: one who knows how to slaughter -- one eats from his slaughter
[one who] can eat an olive-bulk of grain -- one distances four cubits from his excrement and from his urine
[one who] can eat an olive-bulk of roast -- one slaughters the pesach on his behalf
אמאי? טלטול בעלמא הוא, ולידחי שבת! -- why [is the lulav not taken on that Shabbat]? it is mere moving -- let it override Shabbat!
a decree lest he take it in his hand to an expert and carry it four amot in the public domain (= p_rabbah_gezera)
Rabbah: [the lulav does not override Shabbat as] a decree lest one take it in his hand and go to an expert to learn, and carry it four amot in the public domain
the mishna: [when Shabbat falls on] all the remaining days, the lulav is six [days] -- i.e. it is not taken on that Shabbat
the mishna: when the first festival day falls on Shabbat, they bring their lulavim to the Temple Mount
the mishna: [the court] enacted that each and every one takes [his lulav] in his house
the lulav is [taken] six or seven [days]
willow seven, how? when the seventh day of the willow falls on Shabbat -- the willow is seven [days]
